s.note: Carol Anne talking to the snowy TV
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss with 50g melted butter, fine salt, 1 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tbsp black sesame seeds until it looks like TV static. Serve in a bowl in front of the screen.

s.note: Diane turns around and the chairs are stacked
s.how: Slice 150g cheddar, 150g gouda and 150g Swiss thickly. Stack in crooked towers with a cracker between each layer and push a long skewer through the middle to hold them. Make four towers.

m.note: the one that crawls across the kitchen bench
m.how: Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 70 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks (about 250g each) and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, adding 40g butter, garlic and thyme to baste, and pull at 54C inside. Rest 5 minutes. Wilt 300g spinach with 125ml cream and serve alongside.

w.note: Carol Anne's voice from the TV, they're here
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add 180g caster sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall drops and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.

d.note: a hot afternoon in the new estate
d.how: Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each of 4 glasses and pour over 300ml cold orange soda slowly so it foams. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
